label: Finding-41
title: fix-authored: Committer time is not the time a commit became public
description: 3584a98bd's committer date is 2026-10-21T16:06:22+02:00 (14:06:22Z). Git records when the commit object was made, not when it was pushed; and the release tags (13:35:38 UTC, pointing at release commit 136e049 dated 2026-10-19) already shipped the fix before 14:06. Suggested wording: 'committed to the branch at 14:06 UTC'.
